purpose: Determine whether saved serial data supports offline replay of synchronized IMU and ToF height fusion.

audited_files.finding: Contains low-rate attitude, ToF, flow, and PWM summaries; dt_ms describes control-loop timing, not the telemetry sample interval.
Contains aggregate counts and isolated fault snapshots, not a continuous synchronized sensor stream.

result: No saved record can validate the new height observer against synchronized high-rate IMU and ToF input. A future capture must preserve sample timestamps and raw vertical accelerometer/ToF values.
